name: agentic/cta-cards
title: CTA Cards
description: A row of colored cards (image, heading, pill button) — for content teasers like the Journal, a store locator, or a social handle. Each card can also take an optional `text` line (a short description) for a feature-grid look with no button. Set variant:"overlay" for full-bleed panels with a cover background image and the heading/CTA overlaid on top of it, split into as many panels as there are cards.
